pages.title: The ash's own
text: Two of the Wastes' animals live at the edge of lava, one flies through the ash, and one hunts the basalt at night.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with its own food, named under **Hunting and herding** below. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though none of them has a familiar gift of its own.

pages.title: Cinderhide
text: An armoured beast that lives beside lava and on the hot stone around it, one or two at a time. **30 health** and **7 armour**, slow, and **immune to fire**.
It drops **1 to 3 Cinder Plates**, an Ember reagent.

pages.title: Ashmoth
text: A grey moth of the ash, in ones to threes. **10 health**, no armour.
It drops **1 to 3 Ash Wings**, which grind into black dye.

pages.title: Slaglump
text: A slow, heavy lump that wallows by lava, one or two at a time. **26 health** and **5 armour**, and **immune to fire**.
It drops **1 to 3 Slag Curd**, an Ember reagent.

pages.title: Emberjaw
text: An upright, ember-coloured brute that rises on the basalt at night, one to three at a time. It has **32 health** and **3 armour** and hits for **6**, shoving you back with every blow. For all its colour it is **not** fire-proof.
It drops **1 to 2 Ember Fangs**, a Shove reagent.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. Meat drops roasted if the animal died burning. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
- **Cinderhide**: 1 to 2 Raw Game and up to 1 March Leather. Breed with **Emberroot**.
- **Ashmoth**: up to 1 String and up to 1 Gunpowder. Breed with **Emberroot**.
- **Slaglump**: up to 1 Magma Cream and up to 2 Iron Nuggets. Breed with **Emberroot**.
- **Emberjaw**: up to 2 Bones and up to 2 Charcoal.
